150.48.50.10(1).explanation: A lot with a public or private school needs a soft landscaping strip at least 1.5 m wide along all side and rear lot lines, and at least 3.0 m wide along any lot line abutting a street, excluding areas used for play, walkways, driveways, parking, loading and student drop-off and pick-up.
